data.name: Aries Clean Technologies
data.description: Aries Clean Technologies, based in Franklin, Tennessee, designs, builds, and operates patented fluidized-bed and downdraft gasification facilities that convert wastewater biosolids and wood waste into renewable energy plus biochar/Bio-Fly-Ash byproducts. Their commercial-scale Linden, NJ plant processes ~400 tons/day of biosolids, and a second facility is under development in Sanford, Maine. The core business is biosolids disposal and PFAS destruction for municipalities; carbon sequestration via biochar/bio-ash is an adjacent benefit.
